name: 55429 · Brooklyn Ctr, MN
findings: ZIP 55429 (Brooklyn Ctr) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55429 (Brooklyn Ctr) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55429 (Brooklyn Ctr) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
